welcome.title: Welcome to UDVASITO
welcome.privacy: Privacy notice — what we collect and why
welcome.ai: How AI is used: when you type or paste a request, the text (with phone numbers, names and illnesses removed) may be processed by an AI service to fill the form. You always check it before posting. AI never decides who is contacted.
welcome.voice: Voice: your phone's or browser's own speech service turns your voice into text (this may be Google's service). UDVASITO never receives your audio.
welcome.permissions: Permissions we may ask for, only when you use the feature: Location — to find where blood is needed or your area (we never store your live location). Notifications — to alert donors and update you. Microphone — to speak a request. Camera/Photos — to attach a hospital slip.
welcome.consent: I am 18 or older and I agree to the Terms and Privacy notice.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: One tap with your Google account. You'll only do this once.
signin.why: We use your Google account only to sign you in. We never post anything.
signin.helpline: Need blood right now? Call the UDVASITO helpline
signin.practiceNote: Practice requests reach only practice accounts — never real donors. Everything else works exactly like the real app.
signin.practiceLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 15 minutes.
signin.error: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.
signin.notConfigured: Sign-in is not available yet because the server is not connected. Please try again later.

onboarding.title: About you
onboarding.body: Three quick details. You can change them later.
onboarding.name: Full name
onboarding.dobHelp: You must be 18 or older to use UDVASITO.
onboarding.phoneHelp: Shared only inside a blood request you take part in, and with on-duty volunteers when you ask for blood. Never shown publicly.

underage.title: Sorry, you need to be 18 or older
underage.body: Please ask an adult family member to post the request. In an emergency, call the helpline.

verify.title: Verify your mobile number
verify.body: This keeps fake requests out. It takes about 30 seconds and costs nothing.
verify.telegramSteps: 1. Tap the button — Telegram opens. 2. Tap Start, then "Share my phone number". 3. Come back here.
verify.whatsappSteps: 1. Tap the button — WhatsApp opens with a message ready. 2. Tap Send. 3. Come back here.
verify.inPerson: Verify in person (at a campus drive or with a volunteer)
verify.inPersonSteps: 1. Show this code to an UDVASITO admin or volunteer. 2. When they ask, call their phone — they will reject the call, so it costs nothing. 3. They confirm, and your number is verified.
verify.inPersonNotice: When you call, the verifier's phone shows your number. They delete it from their call list afterwards.
verify.mismatch: Telegram shared {{verified}}, which is different from {{entered}}. Use {{verified}} as your number?
verify.expired: The link expired. Tap the button again.
verify.laterNote: You can still post a request now. Until you verify, you can have 1 open request and donors will see "phone not yet verified".

update.title: Please update UDVASITO
update.body: This version is too old to work safely. Download the latest version — it takes a minute.

frozen.title: Your account is paused for review
frozen.body: We received a report and an admin will review it soon. You can still view your open request.

deletion_pending.title: Your account is being deleted

intro.title: Become a blood donor
intro.b1: You'll only be alerted when someone nearby needs your blood group.
intro.b2: Your number is never public. It's shared only with a family you agree to help.
intro.b3: You decide every time — and you can pause anytime.

notLive.group: Add your blood group to start receiving requests.
notLive.consent: Please review the updated consent to keep receiving requests.

donor.alertsOff: Alerts may not reach you. Fix it in 1 minute.

setup.title: Become a donor
setup.unknownGroup: No problem. Many hospitals and blood banks test blood groups for free or at low cost. Add your group here when you know it.
setup.locationNote: We only use it to pick your area. We don't store your location.
setup.genderWhy: Used only to calculate when you can donate again.
setup.checkScreening: I understand the blood bank will check me before I donate
setup.platelets: I'm willing to donate platelets (for dengue and other patients)
setup.plateletsInfo: Platelet donation uses a machine at a blood bank and takes about 1–2 hours. You'll only get platelet requests if you turn this on.
setup.privacyBody: When you tap "I can help" and are confirmed, you and the family see each other's number. Nobody else does.
setup.callMode: Don't share my number — I'll call families myself
setup.consentHealth: I agree that UDVASITO stores my blood group, donation dates and area to match me with requests, and shares my number only as described above.
setup.done: You're a donor now. Thank you! We'll alert you only when you can help.
